description: Foundation: root scaffolding, the canonical shared zod schema + wire protocol, the dependency-free sync-shared script, and the link checker. This is the base every other feature depends on (the schema and sync tooling must exist before backend/frontend can compile). Transcribe shared/schema.ts and both scripts verbatim from design.md.

findings:
DONE 2026-10. All 5 verification commands pass (sync exit 0, check-links exit 0, require exit 0, ignore rules correct). NOT committed (workflow policy: work directly in repo, no commit/push).

SHARED SCHEMA (shared/schema.ts) — imports only 'zod'. Exported values: SCHEMA_VERSION (const 1), Difficulty, Confidence, Actor, Category, ReviewType, ScopeLevel (zod enums), SECTION_KEYS (const tuple), DurationRange, SectionConfidence, Source, GuideSchema (ZodEffects — .superRefine wraps the object, so GuideSchema is NOT a plain ZodObject; cannot call .extend()/.shape on it, use the inner object or z.input/z.infer), toSummary (fn), CONFIDENCE_RANK (const). Exported TYPES: Guide (= z.infer, defaults applied), GuideInput (= z.input, authoring shape — aliases/alternatives/sourceRefs/model/query optional), SectionKey, GuideSummary, and wire-protocol types ErrorCode, ClientErrorCode, Stage, StepStatus, StreamEvent (discriminated union on 'event'), StreamEventName, ApiErrorBody (interface). Note: ServerErrorCode ('CLIENT_GONE') is NOT here — it belongs in backend/src/errors.ts per design. Date rules: generatedAt uses z.string().datetime() so MUST be UTC 'Z' (no offset); lastVerified & sources[].accessed are plain YYYY-MM-DD via IsoDate.

GENERATED LAYOUT: scripts/sync-shared.mjs writes to BOTH frontend/src/generated/ and backend/src/generated/ (gitignored): schema.ts (copy of shared/schema.ts prefixed with '// AUTO-GENERATED from shared/schema.ts — do not edit') and curatedGuides.ts. curatedGuides.ts imports from './schema.js' (literal .js extension in BOTH targets — required by backend NodeNext, resolved by frontend bundler/Vite). It exports `const raw: GuideInput[]` (JSON of guides sorted by app.name) and `export const curatedGuides: Guide[] = raw.map(g => GuideSchema.parse(g));`. With zero guide files it emits `const raw: GuideInput[] = [];` and exits 0. Backend imports: './generated/schema.js' and './generated/curatedGuides.js' (or matching ../ depth). Frontend may import without extension. Guides JSON filename stem MUST equal its slug or sync exits 1. Missing shared/ -> exits 1 with the Vercel 'Include source files outside of the Root Directory' message.

CHECK-LINKS: scripts/check-links.mjs (zero deps) writes shared/link-check-report.json = { checkedAt, results:[{url,guides,status,httpStatus,finalUrl,error?}] } (COMMITTED, feeds PDF). status in ok|redirected|blocked|broken. Exits 1 on broken/missing, 0 otherwise. Needs network; NOT in npm test. Currently writes empty results[] (no guides yet).

ROOT package.json: private, scripts only (sync, check:links, pdf, screenshots), no deps. .gitignore: added frontend/src/generated/, backend/src/generated/, backend/.data/; replaced the 3 .env lines with `.env*` then `!.env.example` (verified: .env.example tracked, .env.production ignored).

NOTE for FEAT-002/004: schema.ts has NOT been typechecked under a real tsconfig yet (no zod installed at root — deferred to those features per design). The generated curatedGuides.ts uses `GuideInput[]` annotation so tsc will reject any invalid curated guide in both apps.
